research.recommended_topic: AI Prompt Hacks for Campus Placement & Resume Building
research.audience_problem: Indian college students and freshers are entering campus placement season stressed about ATS-friendly resumes and technical/HR interview prep, but don't know how to use AI tools effectively to stand out.
research.why_now: August marks the official kickoff of campus placement drives across Indian universities and engineering colleges, making resume optimization and interview prep an urgent, high-stakes daily priority for the 18-24 student demographic.
research.hook: Placement season start ho gaya hai aur resume blank hai? 3 AI prompts jo shortlist ki guarantee badha denge! 🚀
supporting_points: Resume Polish Prompt: Feed your raw project details into ChatGPT to generate ATS-friendly, outcome-focused bullet points.
Mock HR Interviewer Prompt: Turn Gemini/ChatGPT into an intense interviewer that grills you on specific job descriptions and gives instant feedback.
Company Research Shortcut: Use DeepSeek / Gemini to summarize recent company news, tech stacks, and interview trends in 60 seconds before your round.
Kaam ki Baat tip: Never copy-paste AI responses directly—customize numbers, project specs, and personal details to stay genuine.
trend_signals: Even UTC date (2026-08-10) strictly requires an AI content pillar based on brand strategy parity rules.
August is peak campus recruitment season across Tier 1, 2, and 3 Indian colleges.
High Instagram engagement on Indian student feeds for carousel posts offering actionable, career-saving prompts and hacks.

ideas.reasoning: Rides on the viral relatable humor format around salary depletion, using native Hinglish cues that trigger high shares among young Indian professionals facing high metro cost of living.

carousel_outline: Slide 1: [Hook] Salary credit hui nahi ki 5 din mein wallet khali? The real reason your bank balance resets every month.
Slide 2: [The Trap] Small UPI payments feel like zero spending, but 100-rupee chai-snack breaks are silently draining your account.
Slide 3: [Rule 1] The 50-30-20 Desi Rule: 50% Needs, 30% Wants (Swiggy/Weekend plans), 20% Auto-SIP on Day 1.
Slide 4: [Rule 2] The 48-Hour Wishlist Trick: See something online? Wait 2 days. 80% of the time, you won't even want it.
Slide 5: [Rule 3] Separate your spending account from your main savings account. Never keep all your money in your UPI-linked app.
Slide 6: [Summary] Stop letting lifestyle creep win. Swipe back and save this for payday!
